name: Vagabond Jacket Sleet
description: When you need to move like your life depends on it. This lightweight layered jacket-and-poncho combination won't tie you up when things get tight. Finished with a hooded cowl, cross straps, and kit-webbing, the Vagabond is ready for whatever your day may have in store. The Sleet version is dyed a well-worn grey to keep you subtle, but not unsightly.
